definitions.gloss: decorative paper cords; ceremonial cords tied on gift envelopes
definitions.explanation: Thin cords made of twisted, starched paper, used to tie and decorate gift envelopes and wrapped presents in Japan. The color and knot style signal the type of occasion, such as a wedding, funeral, or general celebration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祝儀袋|しゅうぎぶくろ}→祝儀袋：20945_shuugibukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{水引|みずひき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I tie decorative cords on the gift money envelope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水引|みずひき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧{事|ごと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Red-and-white decorative cords are used for celebratory occasions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚祝|けっこんいわ}い→結婚祝い：19656_kekkoniwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{結|むす}び{直|なお}せない⟦{結|むす}び→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水引|みずひき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: For a wedding gift, you choose decorative cords tied in a knot that cannot be retied.

notes:
Traditional Japanese gift decoration made from twisted paper cords (⟦{和紙|わし}→和紙：02268_washi⟧ hardened with starch). The color combination and knot type carry meaning and must match the occasion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水引|みずひき}: red-and-white cords (celebrations)
- {黒白|くろしろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水引|みずひき}: black-and-white cords (funerals, condolences)
- {水引|みずひき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to tie on decorative cords

CULTURAL NOTE:
The knot matters: a ⟦{蝶結|ちょうむす}び→蝶結び：16482_choumusubi⟧ (bow knot, easily retied) suits events that may happily repeat, such as childbirth, while a {結|むす}び{切|き}り (tight knot that cannot be undone) suits weddings and funerals, which should not recur.
